name: The Angel Of Death
overview: Scripture reveals that angels serve as ministering spirits who carry out God's purposes, including the care of believers after death, as seen when angels carry the beggar into Abraham's bosom. While there is joy among the angels over a sinner's repentance, death itself is ultimately defeated, with death and hell cast into the lake of fire, described as the second death. This underscores the hope believers have in Christ, who triumphs over death and grants eternal salvation to His heirs.
